arxiv-2212-02469.title: One-shot Implicit Animatable Avatars with Model-based Priors
arxiv-2212-02469.creator: Yangyi Huang, Hongwei Yi, Weiyang Liu, Haofan Wang, Boxi Wu, Wenxiao Wang, Binbin Lin, Debing Zhang, Deng Cai
arxiv-2212-02469.description: Abstract Existing neural rendering methods for creating human avatars typically either require dense input signals such as video or multi-view images, or leverage a learned prior from large-scale specific 3D human datasets such that reconstruction can be performed with sparse-view inputs. Most of these methods fail to achieve realistic reconstruction when only a single image is available.

arxiv-2301-03382.title: Personnel Scheduling and Testing Strategy during Pandemics: The case of COVID-19
arxiv-2301-03382.creator: Mansoor Davoodi, Ana Batista, Abhishek Senapati, Justin M. Calabrese
arxiv-2301-03382.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mansoor Davoodi, Ana Batista, Abhishek Senapati, Justin M. Calabrese. Efficient personnel scheduling plays a significant role in matching workload demand in organizations. However, staff scheduling is sometimes affected by unexpected events, such as the COVID-19 pandemic, that disrupt regular operations. Since infectious diseases like COVID-19 transmit mainly through close contact with individuals, an efficient way to prevent the spread is by limiting the number of on-site employees in the workplace along with regular testing.

arxiv-2305-06143.title: On the rigidity of Ricci shrinkers
arxiv-2305-06143.creator: Yu Li, and, Wenjia Zhang
arxiv-2305-06143.description: Abstract In this paper, we establish the rigidity of the generalized cylinder N n × ℝ m − n N^{n}\times\mathbb{R}^{m-n} , or a quotient thereof, in the space of Ricci shrinkers equipped with the pointed-Gromov-Hausdorff topology. Here, N N is a stable Einstein manifold that has an obstruction of order 3 3 .

arxiv-2306-04546.title: Querying Circumscribed Description Logic Knowledge Bases
arxiv-2306-04546.creator: Carsten Lutz, Quentin Manière, Robin Nolte
arxiv-2306-04546.description: Abstract Circumscription is one of the main approaches for defining non-monotonic description logics (DLs) and the decidability and complexity of traditional reasoning tasks, such as satisfiability of circumscribed DL knowledge bases (KBs), are well understood. For evaluating conjunctive queries (CQs) and unions thereof (UCQs), in contrast, not even decidability has been established.

arxiv-2504-18972.title: The interplay between Active Galactic Nuclei and Ram-pressure stripping: spatially-resolved gas-phase abundances of stripped and undisturbed galaxies
arxiv-2504-18972.creator: Giorgia Peluso, Benedetta Vulcani, Mario Radovich, Alessia Moretti, Bianca M. Poggianti, Peter Watson, Ayan Acharyya, Augusto E. Lassen, Marco Gullieuszik, Jacopo Fritz, Alessandro Ignesti, Neven Tomićić, Ivan Delvecchio, Amir H. Khoram
arxiv-2504-18972.description: Abstract Context. The gas-phase oxygen abundance of the circumnuclear regions around supermassive black holes (SMBH) has been claimed to be affected by the presence of an Active Galactic Nucleus (AGN). However, an agreement on how this happens has not been reached yet.

pmc-11691292.creator: Eve Root, Grace Caskie
pmc-11691292.description: The field of mental health is not yet equipped to meet the needs of the growing older adult population. More psychologists are needed in the field of geropsychology across all specialties, including end-of-life care. However, no known research has examined psychology trainees’ attitudes or interest in providing end-of-life care to older adults.

pmc-12469694.title: Antitumor and Antiangiogenic Effect of Tannic Acid in the Advanced Stage of Ehrlich Ascites Tumor in Mice
pmc-12469694.creator: Nada Oršolić, Martina Kunštić, Maja Jazvinšćak Jembrek
pmc-12469694.description: Ehrlich ascites tumor (EAT) is a rapidly growing, angiogenesis-dependent tumor characterized by high levels of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF). VEGF contributes to ascites formation, which supports tumor cell growth and the accumulation of tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs), primarily of the immunosuppressive M2 phenotype.

pmc-12599926.title: Developing and validating a clinical prediction model to predict epilepsy-related emergency department attendance, hospital admission, or death: A cohort study protocol
pmc-12599926.creator: Gashirai K. Mbizvo, Glen P. Martin, Laura J. Bonnett, Pieta Schofield, Hilary Garret, Alan Griffiths, W Owen Pickrell, Iain Buchan, Gregory Y.H. Lip, Anthony G. Marson, Muhammad Junaid Farrukh, Francesco Deleo, Francesco Deleo, Francesco Deleo, Francesco Deleo
pmc-12599926.description: IntroductionThis retrospective open cohort study develops and externally validates a clinical prediction model (CPM) to predict the joint risk of two important outcomes occurring within the next year in people with epilepsy (PWE). These are: A) seizure-related emergency department or hospital admission; and B) epilepsy-related death.

pmc-12694780.title: Pancytopenia in the context of hypothyroidism and B12 deficiency: A case report and review literature
pmc-12694780.creator: Fatemeh Karimpour, Mohammadreza Valizadeh, Hanieh Ranjbar, Zeinab Vosough
pmc-12694780.description: Background:This case of pancytopenia due to hypothyroidism and B12 deficiency is rare and severe as a reminder that, upon diagnosis of pancytopenia, endocrine disorders such as secondary thyroid hormone deficiency may need to be considered as a potential cause. Case Presentation:A 38-year-old male presented with progressive weakness, lethargy, and anorexia. Initial labs revealed severe pancytopenia, prompting a hematological workup.

pmc-12737289.title: Humic Substances from Different Sources Modulate Salicylic Acid-Mediated Defense in Plants Infected by Powdery Mildew
pmc-12737289.creator: Rakiely M. Silva, Vicente Mussi-Dias, Fábio L. Olivares, Lázaro E. P. Peres, Luciano P. Canellas
pmc-12737289.description: Modern agriculture relies heavily on chemical inputs to sustain productivity, yet their intensive use poses environmental and health risks. Among these compounds, humic substances (HS) stand out for their ability to modulate plant growth and activate defense responses.
